question_text: Outline how lossy compression and destructive malware can each cause loss of original information.
adaptation_rationale: Retain two sources supported explicitly:lossy compression and malware;exclude unrelated general business continuity topic. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Lossy encoding deliberately discards information that decompression cannot reconstruct. Destructive malware deletes or corrupts file data without authorization, so the original content may no longer be available.

marking_points.criterion: Explains loss/change of original file content.
